mappings.source: Waveshare URDF link and mesh declarations
mappings.notes: All manufacturer link IDs and STL mesh references are preserved in the native body model and render URDF.
The five driven joints preserve manufacturer parent/child links, origins, axes, lower/upper limits, and 0.5rad/s velocity limits.
Collision geometry references the same manufacturer STL meshes as the visual geometry. Contact-rich tasks still require a contact-enabled world before contactTraining readiness.
The passive gripper coupling graph is preserved as mimic metadata. DynamicSimulation actuates only the master gripper joint.

mappings.source: Waveshare RoArm-M1 wiki ST3215 and 1:3 big-arm reduction notes
mappings.notes: 30kg.cm servo torque is converted to 2.941995N*m. Servo output frames bind to active joint axes; joint 2 declares a 1:3 timing-pulley mechanicalReductionRatio, preserving raw servo torque separately from joint-side torque.
Masses and inertia tensors are explicit mesh-envelope estimates for deterministic dynamicSimulation only.

mappings.source: Missing joint damping, friction, stiction, and backlash
mappings.notes: Values are declared estimates. They do not claim contactTraining or hardwareParity.
Contact-rich manipulation remains outside the dynamicSimulation readiness target.
